# Nimbus Nova

Nimbus Nova is a local-task marketplace for people aged 16 and over (under 16 is volunteering only). Posters use the website and workers use a separate mobile app. Both interact through the shared Go API. Nova is a middleman: it connects people and does not hold their money.

## Public content
- [Landing page](/): Romanian product explanation and API availability.

The poster dashboard and admin surface are demo controls, not public indexable content.
